source.title: The Tempering
source.description:
<The branches of Nordrassil create a fire unlike anything you've ever seen. It almost seems to have a will and intelligence of its own. You can't be sure, but you could swear that the flame seems to have some awareness of your presence and regards you with a kind of curiosity.>

<As unsettling as that is, all that remains is to heat the blade and plunge it into the waters of the Well of Eternity.>
source.progress: It is done. The blade is restored, though it still bears the taint of corruption.
source.completion:
You've done so much, but I must ask you to bear the blade to one final destination.

Once there, we can only hope that the soul of Alexandros Mograine has the courage to take the final step.
